thread:
Maya K: Hey all — quick design review for a Compact "rules lane" view in the Routing Policies editor. Figma v2 here: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/routing-policies-compact (see frames: CompactList + RowHover)

Maya K: TL;DR: compact mode shows more rules at-a-glance, introduces a condensed priority affordance, and an inline Preview toggle within each row. Looking for focused feedback on four things:
  1) drag vs arrow reorder affordances (visual and discoverability)
  2) keyboard accessibility / shortcuts for reordering
  3) validation copy for predicate conflicts and how we surface it in compact rows
  4) where the preview simulation CTA should live (row inline vs top bar)

Julian R: Love the density wins. Two quick thoughts:
  - Keep a persistent small reorder chevron on the left for touch users, but make the larger drag handle appear on hover/row-focus for mouse/keyboard.
  - For discoverability, show a brief inline hint the first time someone opens the editor: "Tip: click handle or use Move Up/Down in menu" :bulb:

Olivia S: Keyboard: we should avoid global chord shortcuts that conflict with browser. Prefer an in-row menu with actions:
  - "Move up" and "Move down" (these call the same reorder API)
  - Also support focused reordering using Space to lift + Arrow keys to move, then Enter to drop — mirrors some existing lists.
  - Important: announce position to screen readers, e.g. aria-live: "Rule 3 of 12" after move.

Sam T: Implementation constraints:
  - backend persists order on every change; we should debounce saves (250ms) to avoid thrash when using keyboard hold.
  - reorder event payload: keep minimal: { rule_id, new_index } (we can inline this later). Also watch for KV cache invalidation if we change priority while preview running.

Erin D: Copy tweaks for validation states:
  - Current: "Conflicting rule"
  - Proposed: "Rule conflict — overlaps with higher-priority rule"
  - For compact rows, truncate and show a tooltip on hover with the full message and a link to the conflicting rule.
  - For inline preview, add a subtle yellow bar: "Preview may skip lower-priority rules" when simulation trims matches.

QA Bot: Test checklist additions:
  - keyboard reorder (Space + Arrow + Enter) with SR announcements
  - Move Up/Down from row menu
  - validation message tooltip persists when toggling Preview inline
  - reordering while preview open doesn't crash simulator

deploy-bot: deploy-preview available: https://preview.redwood.test/branches/rules-compact — build 2025-09-10_14:12
  logs: warning rules-lane.scss:42 unused $compact-gap, eslint: reorder-button has console.warn on click

Julian R: One more UX nit: when a reorder is pending save, show a subtle spinner on the handle rather than disable interactions. That keeps flow smooth.

Maya K: Agree on spinner. Action items:
  - @Erin D update copy and add tooltip text (assign to Erin)
  - @Sam T prototype keyboard lift/drop behavior + debounce (assign to Sam)
  - @Olivia S add aria-live example and annotate Figma with SR text
  - @QA Bot add tests listed above
  - @Julian R I'll add the first-run hint microcopy

Erin D: I'll push copy proposals to the Figma text layer and paste final strings here by EOD tomorrow.

Sam T: I'll spike the keyboard in a branch and share a short screen recording.

QA Bot: I'll add tests to the regression suite and link PR when ready.

Maya K: Thanks everyone. Targeting to land for the next sprint (planning on Monday). If anyone has blocking concerns, flag here. :pray:
